page.layout: One page of running text in a single column, no margin notes. Running head at the top, page number at the top left, catchword at the bottom right.

main_text.p: labi,ut sic unanimi voto conspirarent tot enor-mes,& plenas periculi in Ecclesia & Regno No-vitates, omnes Praxi suæ, Judicio, Educatio-ni adversantes invehere.

Neque vero, me fugit, adscitos in huncOr-dinem plurimos impetu & studiis Popularium: quorum nonnulli nil ardentius sitiebant, quàm ut offensas quas in Me vel in Aulam Meam, vel Clerum conceperant, acriter omnes ulcisce-rentur: nulla tamen ratio permittit, ut immen-sam hanc & subitaneam Novandi cupidinem, ultra quàm Paucis Illis imputem, qui se Tur-bâ hac Multicipiti[?] & Multimanâ armârant.

Eadem interim me Ratio hortatur, Honorifque simul & Incolumitatis Respectus Ecclesiæ & Regno debitæ, ut ejusmodi mihi buccellas oblatas lente prius manducem quàm in Sto-machum demittam: Sin conscientiæ meæ an-gustia impediar, quo minus eâ quâ alii facili-tate deglutiam hos in Deum & homines sacri-legii & Injustitiæ Camelos, nulla causa est cur expostulent haud æquè vastum mihi guttur ac illis patere; Id Deo juvante fixum manet, nulla vel perturbatione, vel pervicaciâ, vel contradicendi libidine, vel inani Negativæ Vocis ostentatione ita transversum actum iri judicium meum, ut sim voluntati meæ obsequuturus, quicquam unquam negando, quod Conscientia mea & Ratio negare vetuerit.
Contra, nulli unquam rei ultrà assentiar, ni-si in quantum eâdem Ratione, Iustitia, Honore, & Religione persuadeor, futurum in Dei Glo-

page.notes: Catchword "riam" is at the bottom right and completes "Glo-riam". Printed "huncOr-" has no space before "Or", as printed. The word "Multicipiti" is uncertain. The page number "§o" is an old-style numeral and is uncertain. A small mark stands at the left of the line "Neque vero", possibly a printer's mark or show-through, and is not transcribed. Greek running head is transcribed in Greek letters as printed.
